provenance.author: murmo

cases.note: Lessons 44, 53: the one submit of a run carries exactly the typed synthetic line to the fake server, and nothing else is sent as a prompt.
Accented, CJK and emoji text typed key by key reaches the draft unchanged (wide cells read back as one character); nothing is submitted.
Lesson 61: the newline gesture is Ctrl+J, never a modified Enter, and it must not submit.
A short bracketed paste with a newline lands as two draft lines and does not submit (pi S-Enter incident: a newline must never act as Enter).
Lesson 54: a pasted line plus typed text is submitted whole; Codex pastes go in chunks below its 1,024-byte read.
